title: Bitcoin Whales Are LOADING UP: Buy Signal FLASHING
speaker: Nick Valdez

macro_themes.view: Largest Binance BTC outflow (~23,000 BTC in a week) since June 2023, a past local bottom; whales withdrawing to hold.
BTC tends to bottom ~1 year after its cycle high (Oct 6, 2025); the year is up, so bottoming is likely.
Government debt means money printing; $1M Bitcoin around the mid-2030s.
Many crypto wedges resolve around Oct 8 when the market must pick a direction.
